observations: Photo 0: Open laptop with RGB backlit keyboard, screen on showing Windows desktop with a nature wallpaper. A sticker on the palm rest reads 'Ready to Game' and 'RTX'. The laptop is black with a textured finish. The Aorus logo is visible on the lower bezel of the screen.
Photo 1: Black laptop box with 'AORUS 15G' printed in orange on the side. The Aorus logo is visible, along with an Intel logo. The box has a textured pattern and appears to be original packaging.
Photo 2: Left side of the closed laptop showing ports: HDMI, USB Type-A, USB Type-C, and a power jack. The laptop is black with a textured finish. The Aorus logo is faintly visible on the lid.
